ATP Finals: Ben Shelton beats Rafael Jodar to book Carlos Alcaraz semi-final as Alexander Zverev secures group victory
US Open runner-up Ben Shelton is into the last four of the ATP Finals for the first time after beating Rafael Jodar; Alexander Zverev defeated Arthur Fils in straight sets to continue unbeaten start in Turin; watch the ATP Finals live on Sky Sports
Thursday 19 November 2026 22:17, UK
Ben Shelton faces another semi-final reunion with Carlos Alcaraz after securing his progress from the group stage at the Nitto ATP Finals in Turin.
The American reached the last four for the first time after a straight-sets win over Rafael Jodar on Thursday, with a 7-6 7-5 victory ensuring second spot in the John McEnroe Group.
Shelton will now face the Spaniard in a rematch of their gruelling US Open quarter-final epic, which ended at 3.33am local time, with the meeting the first between the pair since Alcaraz got revenge in the Paris Masters final.

Alcaraz is an injury concern after getting his left thigh strapped during a win over Daniil Medvedev on Wednesday, with the 23-year-old rounding off his group stage against Flavio Cobolli on Friday.
Alexander Zverev beat Arthur Fils 6-4 7-6 in the final match of Shelton's group, ensuring he would finish top and face the winner of Medvedev and Frances Tiafoe in the semi-finals.
Zverev and Shelton progress in Turin
Zverev advanced in straight sets, albeit needing a tiebreaker in a second set that did not see a single break of serve.
The world No 1 appeared to have an issue with his left thigh during the tie-breaker against Fils, grasping his leg at one point, although closed out victory to claim a third consecutive win.
Fils already knew at that point he was heading out, having needed a straight-sets win to stay alive in the tournament.
"Today I thought I played a little bit worse from the baseline, but I'm very happy to have won all three matches, against three very difficult opponents," Zverev said. "I'm happy to be through in straight sets."
Shelton earlier in the day had to dig deep to see off Jodar, with the 20-year-old the first player ever to qualify for the ATP Finals in the same season as his tour-level debut.
Jodar forced a couple of break points in the opening set, with Shelton only losing his serve once but still needing more than two hours to see off the youngster.
"Rafa [Jodar] is one of the best young talents that tennis has seen in a long time," Shelton told the crowd. "To be here playing in Turin in his first year on tour, starting the year outside of top 100, is a ridiculous feat. I hope all you guys recognize how special that is."
In the doubles, Britain's Henry Patten and Finnish partner Harri Heliovaara - the Wimbledon champions - saw their title defence ended as they lost 7-6 (7-5) 7-6 (7-3) to French pair Theo Arribage and Albano Olivetti.

במקביל, אלכסנדר זברב המשיך את רצף הניצחונות שלו בטורניר לאחר גבר בשתי מערכות על ארתור פילס, והבטיח לעצמו את ראשות הבית. זברב יפגוש בשלב חצי הגמר את המנצח במפגש בין דנייל מדבדב ופרנסס טיאפו. הישג זה מגיע למרות סימני שאלה סביב כשירותו של אלקראס שסבל מפציעה ברגלו במהלך השבוע, ולצד סיום דרכם של אלופי וימבלדון בזוגות הנרי פאטן והארי חליווארה.

משחקי חצי הגמר צפויים לספק מתח רב כאשר השחקנים המובילים בסבב מתמודדים על התואר היוקרתי ביותר בסוף עונת הטניס. הטורניר ממשיך לרכז עניין רב בקרב חובבי הענף ברחבי העולם.
